Content-Type correction: the advertised Content-Type for webhook event delivery changes from application/jwe (not a registered media type) to application/jwt (RFC 7519). fillBasisNote: Compliance fill is counted over the 8 Tier-1 banks / 16 Tier-1 insurers present in the roster (the cohort whose deadline binds first); Tier-2 early movers shown separately. Production-directory registration is authoritative; sandbox traffic is secondary demand-side evidence.

prodGrid.note: Green = capability exposed in the production Trust Framework directory AND carrying live 2xx traffic in the public logs. Blue = exposed in production but no live 2xx traffic in the window. Hatched = not exposed for that capability in the production directory. Exposure is unambiguously production (production directory); Nebras publishes no per-environment volumes, so 'live' means observed successful traffic on the capability. Payments traffic is measured on initiation, so a 5xx-only initiation flow shows blue, not green.

adoptionNote: Sandbox 'live' = 2xx traffic in the last two full months on each release's observable endpoints. This is demand-side evidence: no traffic doesn't mean not certified. Bank brands and segments without their own tier (e.g. Liv) aren't counted in tier fills.
